rationale: The last candle shows a massive spike to the day's high ($22.95) on 737k volume in a single minute, pushing price to 100% of the daily range — this is a climactic move with no confirmation of continuation and high reversal risk. The bid-ask spread of 43.6 bps on a $22.95 stock is wide, and entering long at the absolute high after a parabolic candle carries poor risk/reward; entering short into a momentum spike without a clear rejection pattern is equally dangerous. With 210 minutes remaining and today already showing a realized loss, the prudent action is to wait for the price to stabilize and form a clearer directional structure before committing capital.
